agent_prior.notes: In cellular abundance assays readout via GFP fusion, mutations that destabilize thermodynamic folding lead to rapid intracellular clearance. Consequently, core hydrophobic residues and structurally sensitive positions (such as A80, A154, and Y240 in TPMT) are especially intolerant to disruptive substitutions.
